capabilities: Annotate embedded images with pen, text, highlight, shapes, arrows, and badges
Select, move, copy, duplicate, and delete individual drawings
Save the annotated image back to the vault and refresh note embeds
Pick colors by picker or hex/RGB code and undo or redo edits
extras: Desktop only; works offline with no network access, accounts, or telemetry. Install is currently manual until published in the community directory.
intentEvidence: Annotate images inside Obsidian with an Evernote-style floating toolbar
problem: Obsidian can embed images but offers no built-in way to annotate them without exporting to an external editor.
summary: Image annotation editor that opens embedded images with an Evernote-style toolbar for pen, text, highlight, shapes, arrows, badges, blur, crop, and rotate.
